definition_quote.value: "Practice of dietetics" means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health through the provision of nutrition therapy services.
definition_quote.quote: "Practice of dietetics" means the integration and application of the principles derived from the sciences of nutrition, biochemistry, food, physiology, management, and behavioral and social sciences to achieve and maintain people's health through the provision of nutrition therapy services.

value: assessing nutritional needs of individuals and groups
establishing priorities, goals, and objectives for nutrition therapy
providing nutrition counseling in health and disease

methods_authorized.quote: "Nutrition therapy services" means the following services that are directed toward humans: (1) Assessing the nutritional needs of individuals and groups... (2) Establishing priorities, goals, and objectives for therapy... (3) Providing nutrition counseling in health and disease. (4) Developing, implementing, and managing: (A) nutrition therapy of; and (B) food service systems for; individuals and groups. (5) Maintaining appropriate standards of quality in food and nutrition therapy services for individuals and groups.

license_type_structure.quote: "Licensed dietitian" means an individual: (1) certified under this article before July 1, 2019; or (2) licensed under this article after June 30, 2019; to practice dietetics.

medical_nutrition_therapy_authorized.quote: "Medical nutrition therapy" means the component of nutrition therapy that concerns: (1) determining and recommending nutrient needs based on nutritional assessment and medical problems relative to medically prescribed diets

enteral_parenteral_nutrition_authorized.quote: determining and recommending nutrient needs based on nutritional assessment and medical problems relative to medically prescribed diets, including: (A) tube feedings; (B) specialized intravenous solutions; and (C) specialized oral feedings

diet_order_writing_authority.quote: "Medically prescribed diet" means a diet that is: ... (2) performed as initiated by or in consultation with a physician licensed to practice medicine in Indiana or ordered by a licensed dietitian.

diagnosis_treatment_prohibition.quote: Activities of a licensed dietitian do not include the medical differential diagnoses of the health status of an individual.

food_supplement_sales_exemption.quote: The term does not include the retail sale of food products or vitamins.
